jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll focus on designing and implementing 3D model conversion and checking algorithms while helping guide our transition to a modular, component\-based architecture. If you’re looking for a role that combines technical depth with architectural influence, it’s a strong match.

#### **Who are we**


BIMcollab is a global market leader in BIM quality control and collaboration tools, helping the construction industry build smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Making 3D models run smoothly in the browser is anything but simple. Massive files, fast rendering, real\-time interactions \- users expect it all to work seamlessly.


We empower users to create and maintain high\-quality buildings that are circular, energy efficient, and offer a safe environment. We shape the construction industry by facilitating an integrated BIM process with fast, innovative, and user\-friendly solutions that integrate with all popular BIM tools. Through high\-quality, service\-oriented support, we let our users experience the power and joy of a smooth BIM process.

#### **What you’ll do**


As an engineer of our SaaS platform organization, you will work on core capabilities that are critical to the performance, scalability, and quality of our product. Your focus will be on developing and optimizing complex, performance\-sensitive functionality where accuracy and efficiency are key differentiators for our customers.


You will collaborate in a multidisciplinary, agile setup alongside product, engineering, and quality roles, contributing to both the technical direction and the continuous improvement of our platform.


You will:

* Design and implement performance\-sensitive core platform functionality
* Develop and optimize 3D model conversion and validation algorithms
* Contribute to the transition toward a modular, cloud\-enabled architecture
* Work across desktop and cloud environments (Azure, Windows, Mac)
* Mentor and support fellow engineers while ensuring best practices are applied
* Balance new feature development with long\-term technical improvements
* Keep a strong focus on security, quality, and delivered business value

**Our tech stack**


Backend: mostly C\#, with some C\+\+  

Frontend: VueJS, React  

Cloud: Azure

#### **What we offer**


You’ll join a team with international impact and work on a platform used by some of the world’s largest construction companies. You can expect:

* A competitive salary of 4\.900 \- €7\.000 based on experience
* 27 vacation days \+ option to buy extra days
* Strong benefits package including a generous pension scheme
* Green benefits (e.g. home sustainability reimbursements, bike scheme)
* €1,500 annual learning budget \+ room for personal and professional growth
* Hybrid work: 2 days per week at the office in the heart of Eindhoven
* A nearly energy\-neutral office environment
* Monthly home\-office allowance
* Up to 4 weeks per year fully remote from abroad
* Daily catered lunch and fresh fruit

#### **What you bring**

* You have 5\+ years software engineering and have strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and performance.
* You have good knowledge of and experience using, Design Patterns, SOLID principles and TDD and you value an agile mindset.
* You have a proven record of working with large\-scale applications.
* You can mentor and help other Engineers grow or you would like to develop these skills.
* You thrive in a highly collaborative environment where innovation and initiative is valued.
* You have a learning mindset and continually research best practices and new tooling.

**Bonus points**

* You have experience with software optimization and algorithms.
* Knowledge and experience in 3D technology or BIM.
* Knowledge and experience in component based development and API\-first development.

#### **The work environment**


Our engineering team consists of over 40 Engineers, Testers, and Product Owners, divided over six Scrum teams. Our development team is diverse and international (we have over 20 nationalities!), and our working language is English.

  

At BIMcollab, we strive for an inclusive and diverse work environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of their background, gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, or disability. We encourage applicants with diverse perspectives and backgrounds to apply and believe in equal opportunities for all. We value the unique contributions that each employee can make and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and appreciated.

#### **Interested? We’d love to meet you!**


Do you recognize yourself in the above? Then apply immediately! Do you want to know more? Then take a look around at www.bimcollab.com. For questions, you can always call us at \+31 (0\)40 213 1950\.


Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

jobs.description:
As a **Senior Software Developer** at UAB\-Online, you play a key role in the continued development and modernization of our SaaS platform. Our software connects terminals, vessel operators, and supply chain partners worldwide, helping them collaborate more efficiently across liquid and dry bulk operations.


You **design, build, and improve** scalable enterprise applications within a modern Microsoft ecosystem. In addition to delivering new functionality, you contribute to architectural decisions, strengthen our engineering practices, and help reduce technical debt. You combine **strong software engineering skills** with a **practical mindset** and take **ownership** of your work from concept through production.


In this role, you work closely with developers, Product Owners, UX, QA, Cloud, and other colleagues. You enjoy **solving complex technical challenges**, sharing knowledge, and continuously improving the way software is designed, tested, and delivered. You will also have the opportunity to explore how AI\-assisted development and coding agents can improve both our development process and our product.

### **What you can expect**


As a Senior Software Developer, your work combines **hands\-on** development with technical improvement and collaboration. One moment you may be designing and implementing a new feature, while the next you are reviewing code, improving a deployment pipeline, or working with colleagues on the modernization of an existing part of the platform.


You can expect a role in which you have visible impact, contribute to technical decisions, and help shape the future of a business\-critical platform used by maritime organizations around the world.


Your work will include:

* **Designing**, **building**, and **enhancing** enterprise SaaS applications using **C\# and .NET**
* Taking **ownership** of features from initial concept through development and production
* Contributing to the modernization of our platform and the continued development of its architecture

* Collaborating with Product, UX, QA, Cloud, and Frontend colleagues
* Identifying opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve delivery efficiency⁠

  

For this role, we are looking for an **experienced** software developer who **combines strong technical expertise with ownership, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset**. You are comfortable working on both new functionality and existing systems, and you enjoy contributing to long\-term technical improvements.


In general, we look for:

* **Ownership**: you take responsibility for your work, follow through, and actively look for ways to improve results
* **Genuine communication**: you communicate openly and respectfully, listen well, and say what you mean
* **Collaboration**: you share knowledge, ask for input, support others, and help the team make better decisions faster

* **Adaptability** in a dynamic environment with changing priorities
* A proactive approach to **problem\-solving** and continuous improvement
* **Integrity** and **professionalism** when working with business\-critical systems and information
* Comfortable working in an **ISO\-certified environment, including ISO 27001 and ISO 9001**, and following agreed processes for quality, security, and continuous improvement


For the Senior Software Developer role, we additionally value:

* Strong professional experience with **C\#, .NET, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework**
* Experience building and maintaining enterprise\-scale applications
* Strong knowledge of **Clean Architecture**, SOLID principles, and software design patterns
* Experience modernizing legacy systems and **improving** existing platforms
* **Hands\-on** experience with **Microsoft Azure** and modern CI/CD practices
* Experience with **automated testing** and software quality practices
* An interest in **AI\-assisted software development** or AI\-powered applications
* **Strong communication skills** and a **collaborative** approach to software engineering
* The ability to make **well\-considered technical decisions** and explain them to others

Experience with the following is **considered a plus:**

* Maritime, logistics, or supply chain environments

**Senior Software Engineer\- Software Applications**

  

At Oxford Instruments Andor we are devoted to accelerating the greatest scientific advancements of our age. It matters to us that the products we develop make a real difference to our customers and contribute significantly to their research. We want to deliver differentiated, accessible solutions to the widest possible scientific research and industrial communities. We are a market leading organisation with a diverse and inclusive environment.  



Following an internal promotion we are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer\- Software Applicationswill work in the Software team as part of the wider Engineering \& Technology Department.

  

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop and support customer\-facing Windows desktop applications used to control and run experiments on scientific instrumentation. Working primarily with C\#, .NET and related technologies, you will contribute to software solutions that control hardware, acquire and process scientific data, and provide advanced data visualisation and analysis capabilities.

  

This is a hands\-on software engineering role supporting multiple products and projects across Andor's portfolio. You will work closely with multi\-disciplinary teams to deliver robust, maintainable and high\-quality software that enables customers to achieve groundbreaking scientific results.

  

Key responsibilities include:

  

* Design, develop, maintain and support customer\-facing Windows desktop applications using C\# and .NET.
* Contribute to the delivery of software across multiple products and projects within the Software Applications portfolio.
* Develop software that interfaces with scientific instrumentation and hardware devices for experiment control and automation.
* Implement solutions for data acquisition, processing, storage and analysis.
* Contribute to the development of data visualisation capabilities, including advanced 3D and 4D rendering and scientific imaging applications.
* Investigate and resolve software defects, performance issues and customer\-reported problems.
* Participate in software design discussions and contribute to architecture and technical decision\-making.
* Write clean, maintainable and testable code in accordance with engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the development team.
* Collaborate with software engineers, test engineers, product managers and domain experts to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Support software releases, deployment activities and ongoing product maintenance.
* Share technical knowledge and support colleagues through collaboration and peer review.
* Occasional travel to other offices and customer sites

  

The Senior Software Engineer\- Software Applicationswill have:

  

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline or equivalent professional experience in delivering commercial software solutions
* At least 5 years' experience in commercial software development.
* Significant hands\-on experience developing applications using C\# and .NET.
* Proven experience delivering complex software solutions through the full software development lifecycle.
* Experience working within Agile software development teams.
* Experience developing and supporting commercial desktop software applications.

  

This permanent position is based at our Belfast headquarters working a hybrid model.

  

Informal enquiries may be directed to Louise Dooley Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist via email to louise.dooley@oxinst.com

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
### **Enterprise Architect**


Lead the development and execution of the enterprise architecture strategy, ensuring alignment between business objectives, digital transformation initiatives, and technology investments. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in enterprise\-wide architecture, technology governance, application modernization, cloud transformation, and strategic roadmap planning across complex business environments.


The Enterprise Architect will define and maintain enterprise architecture frameworks, standards, principles, and target\-state architectures across business, application, data, integration, security, and technology domains. Working closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, solution architects, and IT teams, the role will drive architectural consistency, technology standardization, and long\-term scalability across the organization.


Key responsibilities include evaluating emerging technologies, guiding enterprise\-wide technology decisions, overseeing cloud adoption strategies (AWS/Azure), and ensuring architecture compliance with security, risk, and governance requirements. The role will establish reference architectures and best practices for API management, microservices, integration platforms, containerization, infrastructure automation, and enterprise data management.


The successful candidate will have a strong background in enterprise architecture, system integration, cloud\-native technologies, and large\-scale transformation programs. Experience with technologies such as webMethods, Kubernetes, AWS S3, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, Redis, Java Spring Boot, .NET Core, Docker, Jenkins, and Terraform is highly desirable. Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, or Zachman is preferred.


Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills are essential to influence strategic technology decisions, chair architecture review boards, mentor architecture teams, and effectively present complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the organization's Enterprise Architecture vision, strategy, and technology roadmap.
* Establish enterprise architecture standards, principles, governance processes, and reference architectures.
* Ensure alignment between business strategy, digital transformation initiatives, and technology investments.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide governance oversight across major programs and projects.
* Drive cloud transformation and modernization initiatives across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic adoption opportunities.
* Collaborate with business and technology leaders to optimize application, data, and infrastructure portfolios.
* Promote enterprise\-wide integration, API, security, and data architecture best practices.
* Guide Solution Architects and technical teams to ensure architectural consistency and compliance.
* Support risk management, regulatory compliance, cybersecurity, and business continuity requirements.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of IT experience with at least 5 years in Enterprise Architecture.
* TOGAF Certification preferred.
* Experience in enterprise technology governance and architecture review boards.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, integration architecture, data architecture, and security architecture.
* Experience within Banking, Financial Services, or large enterprise environments is highly desirable.


This version positions the role at a **strategic, enterprise\-wide level**, which is the key distinction between an Enterprise Architect and a Solution Architect.

**Skills:** Enterprise Architecture , Cloud Transformation , Technology Governance

Als Technical Architect bij Fellowmind verbind je klantdoelen, functionele behoeften en technologie. Je overziet de volledige technische oplossing, maakt complexe keuzes begrijpelijk en helpt teams om op een consistente manier kwaliteit te leveren. Je hoeft daarbij niet op ieder technologiedomein zelf de diepste specialist te zijn. Je weet wel wat er nodig is, betrekt de juiste expertise en bewaakt de samenhang tussen alle onderdelen van de oplossing.

In deze rol analyseer je bestaande technische omgevingen en beoordeel je hoe architectuurrichtlijnen en best practices zijn toegepast. Op basis daarvan breng je de huidige situatie in kaart, ontwikkel je een toekomstgerichte architectuurvisie en stel je een realistische roadmap op om daar stapsgewijs te komen. Je vertaalt business- en functionele vraagstukken naar robuuste technische ontwerpen, referentiearchitecturen en blueprints die richting geven aan de realisatie.

Je zorgt ervoor dat oplossingen schaalbaar, beheersbaar en herbruikbaar blijven door standaardisatie te stimuleren via patronen, componenten, tooling en documentatie. You operate across the full stack of machine and system control: from PLC-based machine control (TwinCAT / Siemens) to higher-level software components in C++ or C#.

You work in either an environment where software is developed from scratch or with large legacy source code, which is tightly integrated with hardware and electronics, requiring a balanced skillset across machine control and modern software engineering.

What excites you as a Software Designer – High -Tech Semiconductor Equipment (PLC / C++ / C#)?

As a Software Designer, you work on technically challenging semiconductor equipment where machine control and higher-level software come together. You translate requirements into robust designs, take ownership of modules or subsystems, and ensure a consistent design from the PLC layer up to system software.

From our office in Erlangen, at customer locations, and remotely when appropriate, you enjoy working on:

Designing and implementing machine control software using PLC technologies (TwinCAT 3 / Siemens) and or SECS/GEM.
Developing higher-level equipment control software components in C++ and C#.
Translating system requirements into integrated hardware–software solutions and challenging requirements to drive optimal designs.
Bridging the gap between control engineering and software engineering disciplines.
Contributing to the development and evolution of both greenfield and legacy architectures for high-tech machines.
Integrating, testing, and commissioning complex semiconductor equipment.
Collaborating within Scrum teams and multidisciplinary engineering groups across software, electronics, and mechanics to deliver high-quality solutions.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field, combined with 5–10+ years of experience in high-tech machine building and software development.
Strong expertise in PLC-based machine control (Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 and/or Siemens) and experience with SECS/GEM combined with solid software development experience in C++ or C#.
Proven experience designing and implementing control software for complex machines and industrial automation systems.
Good understanding of Object-Oriented Design, software architecture principles, and requirements engineering, with the ability to translate requirements into effective technical designs.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and with modern development tools such as Git and Azure DevOps.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bridge machine control and software domains, challenge unclear requirements, and take ownership of solutions.

jobs.title: Back End Developer
jobs.description:
Server Side Developer

Location:
Hybrid
Package:
Negotiable + Benefits

We are looking for a Server-Side Developer to join our team. As a key member of the development team, this server-side focused role will have two main components: you will be expected to work on designing, implementing and maintaining / improving our existing platform; additionally you will be expected to work in a similar capacity on a larger project to rebuild (i.e. version 2.0) the application with a new microservices architecture. The rebuild will involve working collaboratively with a Data Architect & Front-End Developer to help architect the new modules for v.2.0 of the application. This is a custom-built online quote, bind and formal documentation issuance platform, that also offers a range of analytics to assist with underwriting, portfolio analysis and product performance.

The day to day:

Design, develop, and maintain efficient and scalable server-side applications and services.
Write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code using industry best practices and coding standards.
Collaborate with the frontend team to integrate frontend components with server-side logic.
Work with database administrator to ensure optimal data storage and retrieval.
Optimize server applications for maximum speed, performance, and scalability.
Troubleshoot and debug server issues, providing timely solutions.
Implement security and data protection measures.
Keep up to date with emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in backend development.
Work collaboratively on system architecture.

About you:

Extensive experience as a Backend Developer or similar role.
Proven high proficiency in ASP.NET (C#) and SQL.
Experience with backend frameworks and libraries.
Familiarity with database systems, both relational and NoSQL.
Understanding of RESTful APIs and other web service technologies.
Experience with serverless technologies and microservices architecture.
Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with with Azure service i.e. APIM, Azure Function, Event based and caching services
Experience of programmatic interactions with MS Word and Excel.
Familiarity with testing frameworks and test-driven development.
Security awareness and the ability to implement security best practices.
Performance optimization and profiling skills.
Experience with Azure cloud computing platforms.
Knowledge of version control systems, such as Git.
Knowledge of SSO: IndentityServer4/B2C and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) is advantageous.
Able to work independently and collaboratively, take initiative, problem solve, make decisions and turn ideas into code.
Good communication skills, attention to detail and highly motivated.
Familiar with the Software Development Life Cycle process.
Insurance experience is advantageous, but not mandatory.

The rewards:

A negotiable basic salary and all the normal benefits you’d expect (Holiday, company pension etc.)
A collaborative, open and honest environment that is designed to deliver the best outcomes to our clients and staff
A flexible working methodology to enable you to be where you need to be, if you don’t need to be in an office then don’t, if you want to be in an office your welcome to use one.
An environment built around supporting and developing our staff with funding available for relevant professional qualifications.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Team

The Engineering team at FundApps is a team of ca. 50 smart, friendly people who collaborate closely and take pride in delivering best-in-class software and providing an extraordinary experience to our clients. We’re solving some of the most challenging problems in financial services - we operate in petabytes and milliseconds, not optimising the upload of cat photos. Our clients use our service for multiple hours a day - what we do as engineers has a real life impact on thousands of people across the globe!

Our team values are professionalism, sustainability, and psychological safety; we hold each other to high standards, give each other considered and constructive feedback, work smart, and look out for each other. Learn more about our engineering culture here.

The Role

As part of the engineering team, you'll be working on a suite of innovative products that monitor over US$20 trillion in assets under management every single day, used by some of the world's largest Investment Managers. We are looking for a Mid-Level Back End Engineer who can help drive innovation and deliver great software at pace while also keeping sustainability in mind. We need highly motivated, intelligent people hungry for a challenge.

At FundApps, you'll see the inner workings of a fast-growing, bootstrapped scaleup where we expect all Engineers to take responsibility for their part in our success, seek support when needed, and care equally about our products and client outcomes as you do about writing code. We solve business problems through technology, not just ship code.

We like keeping our tech stack modern and are not afraid to invest to keep it cutting edge! As such we’ve recently completed major projects which included distributing our main rules engine using AWS services, migrated terabytes of data from SQL server to Aurora Postgres, replaced our Single Sign On service with Auth0 and converted our frontend to React.

Our Tech Stack

Back-end: C#
Data storage: PostgreSQL; Amazon storage including Aurora, DynamoDB, S3
Infrastructure: Terraform and AWS, using Fargate, Lambdas, Step functions, and a lot more!
Pipeline: GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, Serverless
Front-end: React, TypeScript

How We Work

FundApps engineers have a lot of freedom to solve problems in a way that achieves our outcomes, and works within our values. You will not be micro-managed - in fact, it's the opposite - you will be expected to take ownership of your work from Day 1. To thrive at FundApps, you will need to be comfortable with uncertainty, and embrace change as it comes. We value people who take charge of their destiny and help make things better for everyone around them. We release software when it's ready, not on a schedule - our teams deploy multiple times a day.

We work agile, but do not follow any approach blindly - we seek 1% improvements in everything we do, try new things but don't hold to anything too tightly. Fundamentally, we follow a Kanban-inspired approach, but we also take inspiration from Team Topologies, 12-factor, DevOps culture - and all the good agile practices that you have read about. At FundApps we put these practices to work, reflect, and iterate to make sure our practices continue to serve us well.

Our Engineers look after a wide set of products and technical services; we don't strictly follow a micro-services approach, however we are working over time to evolve our codebase and our core technology to be distributed, cloud-native and resource- and cost-effective to power our growth while doing our bit to help FundApps be carbon neutral.

What You'll Bring To The Team

Background:
You are a mid engineer with generalist knowledge of product development concepts (software design, product requirements, work breakdown) and agile practices (TDD, CI/CD, architecture) and can apply them to solve well-defined problems independently and with your team. You are comfortable writing code in C#, Java or Python.
Work-with-purpose:
You can articulate the value of your own work in larger projects or team-wide goals. You have the space to own and deliver solutions and are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.
Have-courage:
You are comfortable asking for and giving feedback. You help others when needed, and participate in debates, brainstorms, and other team conversations regularly. You build good relationships with your colleagues in Engineering, Product, and the wider company and are able to respectfully challenge each other to understand the problem and come up with the best solutions. As a company, we embrace change and the chance of failure.
Be-transparent:
As a company, we value and aspire for transparency at all levels; you’ll provide work updates to communicate regularly about progress and blockers and reach out for help when needed.
Raise-the-bar:
You seek out opportunities to improve our code, process, and practices; 1% improvements over time improve things for everyone.
Do-more-with-less:
You identify and help implement improvements to processes and standards within the team, seek to optimise our workflow, and share ideas for how to automate manual tasks. As a company we try to minimise meetings (we have meeting-free Wednesdays) and default to asynchronous written communication over long multiple person meetings.

A Few Things To Know Before You Apply
Salary

We are currently hiring across multiple levels and base salary for this role is between £57,000 - £65,000. The final offer will be made based on your experience and your performance during the interview process.

Work Eligibility

We require candidates to have permission to work in the UK without visa sponsorship.

We work hybrid and ask that new FundAppers spend 3 days per week at our shiny London office during their first 6 months, to make the most of getting to know the business and other FundAppers.

After that, our policy is at least 2 days per week in the office to collaborate, connect and make the most of our shared space.

Life at FundApps

🕐 Work/life balance with flexible hybrid working
💚 Wellbeing benefits such as private health insurance, life insurance, a flexible stipend and mental health coaching
💰 Matched pension contribution up to 10%
💰 Peer micro-bonuses through Bonusly
🎓 £1,000 learning budget each year and unlimited professional development leave
💡 Peer-led ‘Brown-bag lunch’ learning sessions and an annual Learning Festival
🚢 25 days holiday leave + an extra day next year if you use it all + an extra day after 3 & 5 years
🧳 5 Years @ FundApps - additional 4 weeks paid holiday leave during your 5th year as a FundApper
👶 26 weeks leave for all new parents regardless of gender, location or family structure
❤️ Volunteering leave
🎁 Birthday off

👩🏾🌈👦🏼🌏👵🏼👳🏽👽

We are proud of the diversity of all FundAppers - it makes us strong. We provide flexibility around religious observances and embrace a variety of cultural celebrations! If you’re looking for a workplace where you can just be yourself, you’re in the right place.

Your Privacy

Any information you submit through our job application process will be used for the purposes of assessing your fit for a role at FundApps. We may also retrieve and store information from your public social media profiles for the same purpose. By applying for this position, you consent to your data being processed in accordance with the FundApps privacy policy.
About FundApps
FundApps is a company powered by experts, with a client community of 1000s and a culture underpinned by ethics. Oh - and we make the best regulatory software so our clients can “get a good night’s sleep now they have FundApps’❃[real client quote]

Many lawyers, ex-regulators, info sec and other experts work for the B Corp that is FundApps. We are all about future-proofing our compliance monitoring and reporting software so we can always monitor the £30trn (and growing) of AuM for the industry’s most active and happy global compliance community [we get top notch NPS + CSAT scores year after year].

Good people, good business, good ethics. We are FundApps.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the job

RoboShadow is a fast-growing UK-based global Cyber Security startup, and we are looking for a hands-on Principal Software Engineer to help us build, improve and scale our engineering function.

It is not a traditional Principal Software Engineer role centred on building new features all day, and it is not an engineering management position. We are looking for a true player-coach: someone technically strong, close to the code, and able to guide other developers and engineers while still getting stuck into the work.

This could suit an experienced Head of Engineering, Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, Principal Engineer, Lead Developer, or even a non-senior Developer or engineer ready to take that next step. You will work closely with the founder, leadership team, product, customer teams, and developers to improve delivery, strengthen the platform, raise engineering standards, and help shape the team as we grow.

PLEASE NOTE: This is an in-office role based in our Shenfield, Essex office (End of the Elizabeth Line), as you will need to work closely with our CTO. Do not apply if you are not willing to travel in 5 days a week.

About RoboShadow

RoboShadow builds enterprise Cyber Security technology across vulnerability management, external attack surface discovery, automated remediation, device monitoring, security benchmarking, compliance reporting, and Microsoft ecosystem integrations.
We are at an exciting stage: the product is live, customers are using it, the opportunity is large, and the engineering function now needs stronger ownership, delivery discipline, technical leadership, and scalable processes.

We use the following tech stack:
C#
Python
Full AWS Microservices
VUE
Java Script

This Role Is For You If You:

Love building technology in a fast-moving startup
Are technically strong and still enjoy getting into architecture, code, bugs, systems, and delivery blockers
Want a step up into a senior engineering role
Understand SaaS products and how engineering, product, customers, support, and commercial teams work together
Are excited by Cyber Security, cloud platforms, automation, AI tools, Microsoft/Azure environments, and data-heavy systems
Are hungry, practical, ambitious, and ready to take ownership
Can work effectively with the RoboShadow team, whether office-based, hybrid, or remote by agreement

What We Are Looking For

PLEASE NOTE: You are going to be going through everyone’s code most of it AI driven and ensure its safe for production, the developers are very diligent, and we have AI but most of your day will be doing code reviews and managing the team / architectural solutions.

We need a Human AI Code Checker, i.e someone who is high in the scale of fluid cognitive ability.

You should be able to demonstrate:
Strong software engineering experience and current technical credibility
Experience shipping SaaS, cloud, or product-based software
Good judgement around architecture, delivery, quality, security, and technical trade-offs
Strong communication with both technical and non-technical people
Comfort working in a startup where priorities move quickly and structure is still being built
A genuine interest in Cyber Security, automation, cloud platforms, AI tools, data, and SaaS products

Why Join RoboShadow?

This is a rare opportunity to step into a senior engineering role and make a real mark in a growing Cyber Security startup.

You will be close to the code, close to the product, close to customers, close to the developers, and close to the decisions that shape the company.

You will help build the engineering function, improve how we work, strengthen the platform, influence product direction, hire great people, and grow with the business.

We are looking for someone ambitious, practical, technical, and hungry. Someone who wants ownership. Someone who can operate in the detail today and grow into a bigger leadership role tomorrow.

Important Application Location Note

This is a full-time role connected to our Shenfield, Essex office (Just at the end of the Elizabeth Line).
You must hold current UK right to work status.

How to Apply

Please email your application and CV to liz@roboshadow.com

jobs.title: Solution Architect - SEP and S&P
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Solution Architect to support the Strategic Energy Planning (SEP) and Strategy & Policy (S&P) functional areas.

This role is accountable for the design and delivery of end-to-end solution architectures that enable strategic decision-making, policy development, and energy system transformation.

The Solution Architect Will

Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance platforms and solutions supporting energy modelling, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Ensure alignment between business strategy, policy objectives, and technology delivery.
Work across multiple domains to enable integrated, enterprise-wide capabilities.
The architect will work closely with data scientists, energy modellers, delivery teams, Business Analysts and business stakeholders to ensure the platform enables complex scenario simulations (e.g., decarbonisation pathways, demand forecasting, market simulations) while maintaining extensibility, performance, and governance.

This role is Hybrid & can be based from Wokingham or Warwick. We continue to support flexible working where applicable.

This role is designated as requiring a National Security Vetting (NSV) clearance. You will usually need to have been a resident in the UK for the last five years to apply for the required level of clearance.

Key Accountabilities

Own end-to-end architecture designs across SEP and S&P capabilities, ensuring alignment to enterprise architecture principles, NESO1, and strategic roadmaps, building comprehensive knowledge of the various technology components and the business capabilities they provide.
Confidently engage with stakeholders across the Programme, being empathetic to their needs and challenges, whilst being able to articulate pragmatic solutions in a calm and professional manner.
Work closely with other DD&T colleagues (including Delivery Partners and Suppliers), actively participating in meetings and workshops to help drive solution related conversations to meaningful conclusions.
Map Solution Requirements to Solution Designs, ensuring desired outcomes are supported, and the implications of solutions being implemented are considered from a technology, people and process perspective.
Ensure architectural artefacts produced (including Solution Options and Recommendations, Solution Intents, and High-Level Designs) are approved/endorsed through appropriate Architecture Governance processes, working collaboratively with Integration, Security, Platform and other SMEs to deliver comprehensive solution collateral.
Collateral produced must be written in an easily digestible way, which is fit for purpose of the audience it is aimed at.
Define innovative solutions which consider non-functional requirements (e.g. Security, Performance, Reliability, Scalability, Stability, Data Archival, and Disaster Recovery).
Provide Support and Guidance to Delivery and Test teams to ensure any changes necessary are validated in the context of the wider solution footprint.
Work closely with Team members and other Solution Architects to define, document and resolve technical dependencies and blockers to achieve business value.
Align to strategy, identifying transitional and tactical solutions when strategic options are not defined or available in each timeframe.
Provide specialist technical support across all solutions.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK by the start of employment. Visa sponsorship may not be available for this role and will be considered in line with business requirements.

About You

Technical Expertise

Strong experience in designing large-scale data and analytics platforms
Expertise in cloud architectures (preferably Azure, including Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, Fabric, etc.)
Experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, distributed systems)
Proficiency in data modelling, especially time-series and simulation datasets
Knowledge of APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures

Energy Domain Knowledge

Understanding of energy systems (electricity markets, renewables, grid operations, or oil & gas)
Experience with energy modelling tools or frameworks (e.g., PLEXOS, TIMES, PyPSA, EnergyPLAN, or similar)
Familiarity with scenario modelling, forecasting, and optimization techniques

Analytics and Modelling

Strong understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning, or optimization approaches
Experience enabling data science workflows (e.g., notebooks, MLOps)
Knowledge of Python, R, or similar for modelling environments

Soft Skills

Excellent problem-solving and systems-thinking abilities
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive architectural decisions

About You

We’re looking for someone who:

Is passionate about enabling net zero and energy system transformation
Has experience delivering complex, cross-domain architectures
Can bridge the gap between strategy, policy, and technology
Has strong experience in data-led platforms and decision-support systems
Is a confident communicator who can engage at business, technical and executive levels

What You'll Get

A competitive salary of circa £72,000 - £80,000 dependent on experience and capabilityAs well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus of up to 15% of your salary for stretch performance, 28 days annual leave as standard, and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%.

Benefits

NESO's flexible benefits programme provides you with more flexibility around your health, lifestyle and protection benefits, here's just a few available:

Flexible Bank Holidays & Holiday Trading
Additional Birthday Day Off
Cycle to Work Scheme, Retail & Gym Discounts
Private Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance & Personal Accident Insurance

About Us

At the National Energy System Operator (NESO), we play a vital role in tackling climate change and securing Great Britain's energy future. We already operate the world's fastest decarbonising electricity system and are working towards our ambition to run it carbon-free for a short period this year - provided the market supplies electricity exclusively from renewable sources. Alongside this, we provide expert advice to government on how to deliver a clean power system by 2030.

In autumn 2024, the Electricity System Operator (ESO) transitioned to become NESO - an independent, expert public corporation with a whole-system view across electricity, gas, and hydrogen. NESO operates independently and transparently, always acting in the best interests of all energy users.

Licensed and regulated by Ofgem, we make impartial decisions that balance sustainability, affordability and security. Our organisation is fully independent from government, the regulator and all commercial interests, with a clear focus on system-wide benefit, long term thing and public value.

The time to deliver is now. Join the energy transformation and help shape the future.

Your energy. Our future. Together

National Energy System Operator (NESO) recognises the potential of bright and talented individuals, and we encourage you to join us as Great Britain’s energy system undergoes an ambitious, exciting, and vital transformation. Together with industry, we are creating a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

More Information

Research shows that some people may hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At NESO, we believe potential comes in many forms and we're committed to a fair, inclusive recruitment

We're committed to building a workforce that represents the communities we serve, and a working environment in which each individual feels valued, respected, fairly treated, and able to reach their full potential. Its project team delivers implementations, development work and change programmes that connect customer requirements with product, consultancy and technical delivery.

This role takes responsibility for software projects across the full lifecycle, from scope and planning through governance, delivery and closure. You will be the main customer contact, coordinating colleagues and third parties who may not report directly to you, while keeping scope, quality, budget and timescales under control. The opportunity is available on either a permanent basis or as a 12-month fixed-term appointment.

Manage the end-to-end delivery of software implementations, development, consultancy and change projects.
Define scope, objectives, deliverables and acceptance criteria, then maintain project plans, schedules, budgets and resource forecasts.
Track progress and manage risks, issues, dependencies and change requests, escalating clearly when delivery is at risk.

jobs.description:
HMRC are looking for eight Senior Solutions Architects (CDIO).

We work with leading technologies often supported by the companies behind them - Amazon Web Services (AWS), SAP, SAS, Pega, Azure, and Microsoft Power Platform to name a few, to develop and implement solution designs.

You will be using these technologies and more to architect IT solutions that work on a UK wide scale across all of HMRC’s tax and benefits including Self-Assessment, VAT, Corporation Tax, and Counter-Fraud, as well as designing systems that support all the UK’s international trade.

Salary:
£58,541 - £72,711 (You may be eligible for an additional non-pensionable allowance, pending a Capability and Skills assessment, with a value of up to £12,000).
Locations:
Birmingham, Bristol, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, Telford, Worthing.

As the tax authority that collects money to fund our UK public services and provide financial support to the people that need it, almost every individual and business in the UK is a direct customer of HMRC. By joining the Chief Digital & Information Office (CDIO) as a Solutions Architect you will be playing a role in helping define HMRCs technology direction and create IT solution designs that make an impact that really matters on a national scale.

This is a challenging role, and we are looking for people who have the skills and determination and help us to realise our vision.

We believe in supporting the personal development of our staff – and of course, IT is always changing, so we offer extensive tailored training and development opportunities.

Job description

See what it’s like to work at HMRC: find out more about us or ask our colleagues a question. Questions relating to an individual application must be emailed as detailed later in this advert.

We are looking for people who can help us rise to meet the challenge, so we want people with the right skills, behaviours and mindset, people who:

Have a fascination in how technology is evolving, and you know the world is changing and want to be a part of that through creating IT solution designs.
Enjoy being a part of building out technology projects that deliver results.
Have an interest in, or knowledge of, machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies.
Can solve real world business problems through creative IT solutions.
Can work collaboratively as part of a larger team.

If you can answer yes to any of these questions, then these roles may be just what you have been looking for.

We’re bolstering our solution architecture function – working on some of the most complex problems for the UK; simplifying how citizens engage with HMRC, managing the border and driving down on those who try to avoid their obligations for the benefit of our citizens.

Person specification

Your responsibilities in this role will include:
Leading a team of solution architects within one or more strands of IT Change Programmes, setting direction for the team and delivering results.
Accountability for producing technical IT Solution Designs on projects that align to the HMRC IT Strategy and deliver business outcomes.
Responsibility for authoring costed design documentation, working closely with business stakeholders and technical architects to create cohesive solutions that meet the business and user needs.
Working with Delivery Teams and partners to ensure the Solution Design is delivered and implemented.
Building strong relationships with key business and CDIO partners.

This role may require travel and overnight stays.

Essential Criteria:

You have experience in developing solutions at pace through Architectural Governance and managing architecture risks.
You have working on multiple significant large scale complex IT change/ transformation programme designs.
You will be able to pick up new technologies and architecture concepts and styles quickly, understand their strengths and weaknesses and apply that learning.
You are a collaborative problem solver, working with colleagues to identify root causes allowing you to create and deliver pragmatic IT solutions.
You have a proven ability to collaborate with stakeholders with a broad spectrum of viewpoints and to document and present their views from an architecture perspective.
You have experience of building your own and others architecture capability.

THRIVE, GROW and SHAPE THE FUTURE

People always come first at Columbus. We’re a global digital consultancy with a local presence, helping businesses transform and thrive through technology, data, and human insight. Just as importantly, we’re a workplace where careers are nurtured and development is supported through clear, structured career paths.

Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to delivering customer success. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll find the freedom to explore ideas, challenge convention, and shape your own path.

Diversity and Inclusion are close to our hearts.

By joining our team, you will be part of a supportive network that values your voice, respects your ideas, and promotes a healthy work-life balance. Our average length of service in the UK is 8 years, as we are committed to cultivating an inclusive workplace culture that celebrates and supports career growth and advancement in becoming a Trusted Advisor. We provide equal opportunities for everyone, ensuring a level playing field for all candidates. We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds to apply for positions across our organisation, and in return, we will give you the tools and support to Thrive
with us, Grow
your Skillsets, and be empowered to Shape the Future
.

The role of Technical Architect

We're looking for a Technical Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale solutions across Microsoft Azure and Dynamics 365 F&O.

Our primary aim is to recruit a Principal-level Technical Architect, particularly someone with strong experience in Dynamics 365 FSCM and Azure integration architecture. However, we also want to hear from strong Senior Technical Architects who demonstrate the breadth, technical leadership and potential to progress into a Principal role.

This is a broad technical architecture position rather than a narrowly defined integration role. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on technical leadership, working with customers, delivery teams and senior stakeholders to shape end-to-end solutions across the wider Microsoft technology stack.

We're particularly interested in architects with strong experience in Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management and Azure integration architecture, while recognising that strong technical architects naturally develop different areas of depth across the Microsoft technology stack.

Travel and Hybrid Working

We have an environment that gives you the flexibility to achieve an effective work-life balance for you and your family, whether you want to work from home or at one of our luxury Cubo offices around the UK.

We continue to offer our customers onsite consultancy time if requested, so flexibility around travel and overnight stays is expected, depending on the project requirements. Onsite time is planned ahead of time, within 2-week blocks, so you know well in advance where you will be working.

We encourage those in customer-facing roles to aim to come into the office at least once a month, and also team meetings and client meetings; however, you can work from Nottingham HQ or any Cubo office regularly if you prefer, whichever suits you.

About You (The Essentials)

Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale solutions on Microsoft Azure.
Strong architecture and technical leadership experience, including guiding delivery teams and reviewing solution designs.
Hands-on knowledge of Azure application and integration services such as Service Bus, API Management, Functions, Logic Apps and App Services.
Experience designing integration solutions using enterprise integration patterns, APIs, messaging and event-driven approaches.
Good understanding of identity, security, networking and non-functional requirements in Azure solutions.
Good working knowledge of Dynamics 365 FSCM and its core business processes, with an understanding of how areas such as finance, order management, inventory, warehousing and production influence solution and integration design.
Familiarity with Dynamics 365 FSCM integration approaches, including OData, data entities, DMF, business events and related patterns.
Significant experience in a customer-facing consultancy, partner or professional services environment.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, facilitate workshops and influence senior stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, commercially aware approach.
Full driver's licence and access to a vehicle, with flexibility around travel and working hours
Curious, looking to challenge the status quo and improve.
Collaborates well with both internal and external colleagues
Committed to personal development and becoming a Trusted Advisor in your field.

What we can offer

You will be a part of both a local and global team, where you not only share knowledge but also a laugh or two. We value our employees and leave room for flexibility so that you can enjoy a work-life balance.

At Columbus you will get;-

25 Days Annual Leave (Increasing with Service)
Columbus Benefits Hub – Discounts on Tickets, Shopping, Car leasing, Holidays, Food and More
Enhanced Maternity Pay
Access to Free Training Courses Delivered by Columbus Academy
Free Microsoft Certifications and access to Microsoft Learn
Modern Airconditioned Office Spaces fully managed by Cubo (multiple UK locations)
Free Barista Coffee and hot drinks made in-house
Free Beer and Fizz every day (2 - 5pm)
Casual Dress Code in our Offices
Personal Pension Plan
Life Assurance x4 Salary

£2,500 payment for successful candidate referrals (if eligible)

Plus many many more (check out our careers pages for details)

Employee Wellbeing Program (terms apply)

Westfield Health Cash plan (includes an Employee Assistance Line)
Mental health first aiders
Virtual suggestion boxes

Next Steps

If this sounds like the role for you, then please drop a copy of your CV over today via our website and “Apply for this job” or CV not up-to-date? then apply using your LinkedIn profile in seconds.

You may also be prompted to "Connect with us", but please don’t worry if you don’t have the time; it does not impact your application.

In the meantime, check us out on Instagram or Linked In

STAY CURIOUS
, COLLABORATE
, BUILD TRUST
, and DELIVER CUSTOMER SUCCESS

Gold Partner and Inner Circle

As a Microsoft Gold Partner for over 20 years, Columbus has access to a range of market-leading resources, training and certifications. As well as a host of awards, Columbus has twice been named partner of the year by Microsoft.

As Microsoft Inner Circle members, Columbus has been recognised as part of an elite category of partners. Netcompany was founded in 2000 with the headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Today, we are an international company with more than 9000+ employees working from over 10 locations. We serve a wide array of customers in their digital transformation journeys in public and private sectors across Europe.

We are excited by the challenge of doing things differently. At Netcompany we rely on one another and we develop quickly. We are team players. We change societies by creating life-changing IT solutions for variety of customers – from small private companies to large projects in the public sector. Our culture builds on low bureaucracy with a strong focus on high agility and flexibility.

Job Description

Continue your development with us

In Netcompany we focus on your personal and professional development. We offer a structured career model where you can build upon the experiences you bring with you.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will be your sparring partner for your ongoing development as well as for your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in the leadership group provides you with concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and wishes.

Furthermore, you will participate in our training program, Netcompany Academy, where you will be offered courses and seminars tailored to your career stage. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your expertise. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company also creates a strong network and provides a solid foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Be a part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we prioritize community highly. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture that is built on collaboration and trust, and where there is always room for mutual sparring and support.

It is part of our culture and values that all employees, irrespective of backgrounds, identities, and experiences, are met with understanding and respect, as well as equal opportunities for development and well-being.

You will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate with colleagues from various cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices in many countries.

We provide a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we offer a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network already early in your career.

As our new colleague in the Cloud Platform Services team, you will play a key role in agile projects for both large Danish and international customers. You have a unique opportunity to be part of a team responsible for multiple disciplines: Cloud Governance, Cloud Operations, Cloud Center of Excellence, and Cloud Consultancy.

We design and implement business-critical solutions on state-of-the-art infrastructure for customers, where you get hands-on experience with Azure. You will help build and operate our central architecture and solutions, impacting all our cloud solutions across all customers. You will ensure operations in the intersection of infrastructure, security, and the development of customer solutions. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to be lent out to other projects within the organization as a cloud consultant for both shorter and longer periods. All of which we convert to services that enhance and develop our central capability.

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, Your Tasks Will Include

Monitoring, alerting, automation, and scaling of cloud solutions.
Creating coherence between development, operations, and security in accordance with DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tasks, e.g., Terraform, Bicep.
Operating with Version controlling system, e.g., Git.
Automation and standardization of Cloud Infrastructure processes (PowerShell/ Azure CLI).
Design and implementation of Cloud governance solutions.
Delivering internal methods/methodologies/principles into customer projects.
Leading or contributing to technical initiatives in the internal cloud infrastructure through experience from customer projects.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

Have a bachelor's, master's, or engineering degree in ICT/IT, computer science, software/computer engineering, infrastructure, or other relevant vocational education experience.
Have experience with coding/scripting (.NET, Java, Web, PowerShell, Python) and/or DevOps (Terraform, CI/CD) from education or previous work.
Have experience with Azure or other Global Cloud Providers (e.g., AWS, GCP, OCI) from education or previous work.
Possess an analytical mindset, are motivated, and know how to work in a structured manner.
Have good communication skills and Teamwork.
Have an excellent command of the English Language (written & verbal).
Have to be a member of the on-call duty shift outside of business hours.
It would be beneficial (but not a must) if you:
Have work experience.
Have experience with infrastructure and operations.
Have experience with IaaS or PaaS services in cloud-hosted environments.
Have certification in Azure or other relevant Microsoft areas.
Have experience with Kubernetes, containers, or Docker.

Additional Information

Benefits we offer:

Scandinavian work environment.
Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Multisport Card.
English and Danish language lessons.
Drinks, snacks & fruit available at the office.
Career development programme for each employee and regular feedback.
Internal and external training and certifications.
International cooperation with colleagues from Denmark, the Netherlands, Norway, the UK, and Vietnam.
Attractive office with a view and great location in Warsaw (Metro Wilanowska).

jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer, AI Platform & Agents
jobs.description:
Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day.

We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most. You’ll make a real difference in the lives of millions of people. Together with our customers, we help to advance sustainability, health, justice, prosperity, and commerce around the world.

You can thrive at Wolters Kluwer, where diversity is core to our collective strength and high performance. Be your unique self, share your creative ideas, do your best work, and take time to grow in our caring and inclusive culture where you can belong.

About This Role

Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development, validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical industries.

You'll join a 100-engineer team within a larger organization that combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to production, mentor less experienced engineers, and lead by example. You'll design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the development of the most impactful AI agents.

Flagship Agent: UpToDate Expert AI

In Health, we’re launching UpToDate Expert AI
—a medical research and clinical reasoning agent that transforms the world’s most widely used point‑of‑care knowledge resource into a real‑time medical assistant. Millions of physicians will rely on it to accelerate differential diagnosis, refine treatment decisions, and reduce cognitive load—while maintaining rigorous safety, privacy, and guideline fidelity. Improvements you ship (latency, reliability, hallucination reduction) will translate directly into faster, higher-quality patient care at global scale.

What You’ll Do

Design and implement full‑stack applications, AI agents, and platform components that enable rapid GenAI agent development, validation, and deployment.
Build developer tooling, CI/CD, and observability for safe, fast iteration (evals, canaries, rollout/rollback, cost and quality telemetry).
Apply secure SDLC and privacy‑by‑design practices (threat modeling, least privilege).
Collaborate with product, UX, and domain experts to deliver customer‑focused solutions with measurable outcomes.
Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool-use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time-to-decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.
Lead by example and be heavily hands-on: drive architecture, mentor engineers, and take ownership of larger projects.

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong full‑stack development skills and cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:
AI Agent development and evaluation
Backend development
Frontend development
Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)
CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Quality engineering / testing strategy
Secure SDLC and privacy by design

Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud‑native systems to production.
Excellent problem‑solving, ownership, and cross‑functional communication.

Nice to have

Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a small, fast-paced team.
Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous improvement.
Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems; OpenSearch.
Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.
Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine-tuning and model adaptation.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOC2, HIPAA, etc.

Stages

15‑minute intro screen
2× live coding in your preferred language
1× systems design
1× presentation of past work

Timeline:
Typically 2–4 weeks

Your first months

Month 1: Deep-dive into one platform component most aligned with your
expertise; ship small improvements while ramping up.
After onboarding: We’ll align on a high-impact area that fits your strengths
and ambitions.

To apply:

Please submit your resume
along with a brief cover letter
that includes a “Statement of Exceptional Work.”
In your cover letter, highlight one of your most impactful projects by addressing the following:

Your role and the problem space you were working in
The technical and product challenges you faced, and how you addressed them
The measurable impact of your work (e.g., metrics, outcomes, improvements)

This will help us better understand your approach to solving complex problems and the value you bring to the team.

Please do not include any proprietary or confidential information
in your submission

Be the Difference | If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
Ready to utilise your problem-solving skills to analyze, create, modify, and support complex systems and operations that enable automated business processes?

Are you passionate about working with a global company where you can future-proof your career in a supportive and inclusive environment?

Join us as an RPA Solution Architect!

Contract : Permanent

Location: Letterkenny (2/3 days in the office)

Careers at TCS: It means more.

TCS is a purpose-led transformation company, built on belief. We do not just help businesses to transform through technology. We support them in making a meaningful difference to the people and communities they serve - our clients include some of the biggest brands in the UK and worldwide. For you, it means more to make an impact that matters, through challenging projects which demand ambitious innovation and thought leadership.
Work closely with the range of teams within the business to bring products to life.
Gain exposure to innovative technology.
Shape the future of TCS.

The Role

As an Intelligent Automation Solutions Architect
within the Automation Centre of Excellence (CoE), you will be responsible for designing, governing, and delivering enterprise automation solutions that drive operational efficiency and business value. Working closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, and automation developers, you will assess automation opportunities, define scalable solution architectures, and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.

This role requires deep expertise in the UiPath platform, strong technical leadership, excellent communication skills, and a strategic understanding of the overall automation landscape, including emerging technologies such as Agentic/AI Automation, and enterprise integration capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Design scalable, secure, and maintainable automation solutions that align with business and technical requirements.
Participate in requirements gathering sessions and provide technical feasibility assessments and solution recommendations.
Lead solution design activities and produce supporting technical documentation where required.
Perform code reviews and solution reviews to ensure quality, consistency, and adherence to development standards.
Develop and maintain reusable frameworks, libraries, and architectural components.
Contribute to automation development activities, particularly for complex or enterprise-wide solutions.
Collaborate with business stakeholders and technology teams to translate requirements into effective automation solutions.
Establish and promote development standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across the automation estate.
Design and implement API-based integrations between automation solutions and enterprise systems.
Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server database components, including tables, schemas, stored procedures, and integration frameworks that support automation solutions.
Mentor and provide technical leadership to developers within the Automation CoE.
Maintain awareness of industry trends and emerging technologies across RPA, AI, and Intelligent Automation.

Your Profile

Key Skills/Knowledge/Experiences:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
Proficiency with the UiPath platform and enterprise automation solution delivery.
Demonstrated experience implementing and supporting production solutions using UiPath Document Understanding, Communications Mining, Apps, Integration Service, and other Intelligent Automation capabilities.
Proven experience designing, developing, and delivering UiPath automation solutions throughout the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering through production support.
Experience with UiPath Maestro, Agent Builder, Autopilot, or similar agent orchestration technologies.
Strong experience designing and implementing API-based integrations between UiPath automations and enterprise applications.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including database design, schema development, stored procedures, and database integration within automation solutions.
Experience conducting technical feasibility assessments and defining solution architectures for complex business processes.
Experience establishing development standards, performing code reviews, and promoting best practices across automation teams.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.
Experience mentoring automation developers and providing technical leadership within an Automation Centre of Excellence.
Ability to evaluate emerging automation technologies and recommend solutions that align with enterprise objectives.

Good to have:

Experience within Banking, Financial Services, or other highly regulated environments.
UiPath Solution Architect, Advanced Developer, or other relevant UiPath certifications.
Claude Certified Architect, or equivalent AI/LLM architecture certification.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, Codex, Google Gemini, or other enterprise AI platforms.
Good understanding of Python and C#/C++/VB for custom integrations, workflow extensions, and automation-related development.
Experience with Process Mining, Task Mining, or Process Intelligence solutions.

TCS is consistently voted as a Top Employer in the UK and globally. Our competitive salary packages feature pension, health care, life assurance, laptop and access to extensive training resources and discounts within the larger Tata network.

Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Staff Engineer to join our rapidly growing engineering team. This role is for someone who is passionate about building innovative solutions and being exposed to new challenges and technologies while making an impact. This role is available to candidates in Toronto, Dublin, and Barcelona.

What your team does:

We at Clio have an amazing team that is on a mission to transform the legal experience for all, and our engineering team's goal is to deliver an incredible experience to our customers. To enable our engineers to build the best product they can, our development team has to build the best possible product that is performant, reliable, scalable, and beautiful.

Our team establishes the technical foundations that enable dev teams to build global-ready products without sacrificing development speed.

A day in the life might look like:

Acting as a technical stakeholder for multiple projects within your area of focus;
Partnering with development managers in defining the technical roadmap for an area;
Identifying and resolving technical big rocks that unblocks product opportunities;
Writing high quality and well-tested code;
Collaborating with a team of developers to solve complex problems and provide elegant solutions to Clio customers;
Recognizing when the simple solution is the right one;
Simplifying coding patterns, interfaces, and abstractions to make them more approachable;
Using a wide variety of technologies, learning new things, and challenging yourself;
Reviewing and providing feedback on a peer's code, both from within your own team or across all of Clio. Thrive as #TeamClio;
Teaching and learning from those around you - providing constructive feedback to those around you, and taking on feedback to help grow.

What you may have:

Experience in software development, specifically with building web applications at scale and Ruby on Rails;
The ability to master new technologies quickly and work effectively in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment that includes distributed teams and customers;
Demonstrated success in mentorship in software development, particularly using an Agile process and with large scale SaaS products;
A diverse base of knowledge that allows you to help your team solve complex technical problems;
A portfolio of successful projects (as well as a collection of lessons learned from failed projects);
Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with fellow Clions and customers; and
International/global development experience is a plus, but not required.

This is a new role.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The expected salary range for this role is $176,000 to $264,000 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
