jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Want to build the heart of modern commerce with zero technical debt?

Omnium develops a 100% cloud-based Order Management System (OMS) that helps businesses consolidate and handle orders from all sales channels; e-commerce, customer service, POS systems and more. Our solution simplifies complex processes and creates a seamless and efficient shopping experience.

We like to call ourselves a start-up with eight years of experience. With some of the Nordics' largest retail and brand players in our customer portfolio and a rapidly growing market, we are well positioned for further expansion. With us, you'll help build a product in strong development – with modern technology, high pace and no legacy.

THE ROLE

As a fullstack developer at Omnium, you'll become part of a cross-functional development team. You'll work closely with a modern SaaS platform built on .NET, with Azure, Elasticsearch and Vue.js, used by some of the Nordics' largest commerce players. You'll work across the stack, from backend to frontend, and take technical ownership of how functionality is designed, built and further developed in production.

This is a domain-heavy role. Our customers are retailers and brands running high volumes across e-commerce, stores and customer service, and their business logic lives in our platform — orders, inventory, fulfilment, returns, payments, channel complexity. Setting up Omnium well means genuinely understanding how each customer operates, so we're looking for someone who recognises these processes from experience and can translate them into solid technical solutions.

HERE YOU'LL GET:

Technical ownership of the development of a complex and modern SaaS platform
Variety between back-end (C#/.NET, integrations, API development) and front-end (Vue.js)
A short path from idea to production in close collaboration with product and design
Significant influence on architecture, technical choices, priorities and how we work as a development team
The opportunity to work in a strong technical team where you actively participate in code reviews and technical discussions, contributing to better code quality, performance and stability

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Experience building systems for retail or e-commerce, for example OMS, ERP, e-commerce platforms, POS, WMS, payments or logistics. This is a requirement: you need to understand the commerce domain, not just the code
5+ years of experience as a developer, preferably from SaaS or other complex systems in production
Solid expertise in C# and .NET and experience building robust backend services and APIs
A good understanding of architecture, domain modelling, API design and databases
The ability to make deliberate technical choices based on scalability, performance and maintainability
Experience with modern frontend frameworks is an advantage, ideally Vue.js
Strong communication skills in Norwegian and English, and the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

WHAT WE OFFER

Influence: Direct influence on architecture, technical choices and priorities, with short paths from technical proposal to decision.
Product and complexity: A modern and rapidly scaling SaaS platform in heavy use, with complex and business-critical problems to solve.
Startup pace, mature platform: We combine high speed and short decision paths with 8 years of experience and a strong customer portfolio.
Flexibility and security: A flexible workday, competitive terms, and solid pension and leave arrangements.
A social and supportive environment: A low threshold for humour, professional sparring and social initiatives, including company trips and events.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYER

At Omnium, we place a high value on collaboration, learning and well-being. We're an engaged team that combines extensive experience with a start-up mentality, and we work together to create an unparalleled product. With us, you'll become part of an environment where we lift each other up and share knowledge, all to ensure both our own and our customers' success.

We have been named one of the 50 fastest-growing tech companies in Norway several years in a row.
